class Authorization
  list_action_descriptions(cursor: str, limit: int) -> DescriptionPage
  decide(action: str, resource: str) -> Decision
  decide_for(subject: Subject, action: str, resource: str) -> Decision
class AuthorizationClient(Authorization)
  __init__(transport)
  list_action_descriptions(cursor: str, limit: int) -> DescriptionPage
  decide(action: str, resource: str) -> Decision
  decide_for(subject: Subject, action: str, resource: str) -> Decision
class AuthorizationOperator
  register_described_action(expected_revision: str, description: ActionDescription) -> DescriptionEdit
  apply_first_use_allow(expected_revision: str, question_id: str) -> PolicyEdit
  list_policy(cursor: str, limit: int) -> PolicyPage
  set_rule(expected_revision: str, rule: PolicyRule) -> PolicyEdit
  revoke_rule(expected_revision: str, subject: Subject, action: str, resource: str) -> PolicyEdit
  stop_answerer(expected_revision: str, answerer: Subject, also_revoke_grants: bool) -> PolicyEdit
  revoke_answer_permits(expected_revision: str, answerer: Subject, target: Subject, actions: list[str], resource: str, question_id: str) -> PolicyEdit
  set_rule_for(expected_revision: str, rule: PolicyRule, ttl_ms: int, why: str) -> PolicyEdit
  set_rules_for(expected_revision: str, rules: list[PolicyRule], ttl_ms: int, why: str) -> PolicyEdit
  read_rule(subject: Subject, action: str, resource: str) -> RuleRead
  register_action(expected_revision: str, action: str) -> ActionEdit
  retire_action(expected_revision: str, action: str) -> ActionEdit
  explain_for(subject: Subject, action: str, resource: str) -> DecisionExplanation
  list_defaults() -> DefaultPage
  set_default(expected_revision: str, name: str, on: bool) -> DefaultEdit
class AuthorizationOperatorClient(AuthorizationOperator)
  __init__(transport)
  register_described_action(expected_revision: str, description: ActionDescription) -> DescriptionEdit
  apply_first_use_allow(expected_revision: str, question_id: str) -> PolicyEdit
  list_policy(cursor: str, limit: int) -> PolicyPage
  set_rule(expected_revision: str, rule: PolicyRule) -> PolicyEdit
  revoke_rule(expected_revision: str, subject: Subject, action: str, resource: str) -> PolicyEdit
  stop_answerer(expected_revision: str, answerer: Subject, also_revoke_grants: bool) -> PolicyEdit
  revoke_answer_permits(expected_revision: str, answerer: Subject, target: Subject, actions: list[str], resource: str, question_id: str) -> PolicyEdit
  set_rule_for(expected_revision: str, rule: PolicyRule, ttl_ms: int, why: str) -> PolicyEdit
  set_rules_for(expected_revision: str, rules: list[PolicyRule], ttl_ms: int, why: str) -> PolicyEdit
  read_rule(subject: Subject, action: str, resource: str) -> RuleRead
  register_action(expected_revision: str, action: str) -> ActionEdit
  retire_action(expected_revision: str, action: str) -> ActionEdit
  explain_for(subject: Subject, action: str, resource: str) -> DecisionExplanation
  list_defaults() -> DefaultPage
  set_default(expected_revision: str, name: str, on: bool) -> DefaultEdit

class SelectorAuthorizationOperator
  list_selector_rules(cursor: str, limit: int) -> SelectorRulePage
  read_selector_rule(subject: Subject, selection: PermissionSelection) -> SelectorRuleRead
  set_selector_rule(expected_revision: str, rule: SelectorRule, ttl_ms: int, why: str) -> SelectorEdit
  remove_selector_rule(expected_revision: str, subject: Subject, selection: PermissionSelection) -> SelectorEdit
  apply_bundle(expected_revision: str, subject: Subject, bundle_ref: str, selector: ResourceSelector, ttl_ms: int, why: str) -> SelectorEdit
  remove_bundle(expected_revision: str, subject: Subject, origin_id: str) -> SelectorEdit
  apply_permission_allow(expected_revision: str, question_id: str) -> SelectorEdit
  undo_permission_effect(expected_revision: str, question_id: str) -> SelectorEdit
class SelectorAuthorizationOperatorClient(SelectorAuthorizationOperator)
  __init__(transport)
  list_selector_rules(cursor: str, limit: int) -> SelectorRulePage

  set_selector_rule(expected_revision: str, rule: SelectorRule, ttl_ms: int, why: str) -> SelectorEdit
  remove_selector_rule(expected_revision: str, subject: Subject, selection: PermissionSelection) -> SelectorEdit
  apply_bundle(expected_revision: str, subject: Subject, bundle_ref: str, selector: ResourceSelector, ttl_ms: int, why: str) -> SelectorEdit
  remove_bundle(expected_revision: str, subject: Subject, origin_id: str) -> SelectorEdit
  apply_permission_allow(expected_revision: str, question_id: str) -> SelectorEdit
  undo_permission_effect(expected_revision: str, question_id: str) -> SelectorEdit
